{{Top|leg}}
'''Fifthmonth''' was a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] in [[Derilyn]]'s calendar. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the first [[Local day/Legends|day]] of Fifthmonth.
